svg.title: From Revelation to Matthew: the ledger of relations
svg.desc: Each line joins a place in Revelation (top, chapters 1 to 22) to the place in Matthew (bottom, chapters 1 to 28) that holds the same relation with a stated change. 158 rows of the ledger. Lines cross because the source is held open and not followed in order.
svg.text: Each line is one checked relation of the ledger (158 rows): a place in the Apocalypse, the move, the place in the Gospel. The lines cross because a writer holds the source open.
